text:
zoe: thinking of a compact 50m webinar format: 20m demo, 20m live prompts, 10m wrap. want it interactive and lead-gen friendly
kai: sounds good. we need a clear gating on submissions to avoid overload. cap live submissions at 150 simultaneously
mike: infra plan: websocket leaderboard, scoring pool of lambdas, queue fallback. dry-run needed Tue 10am
nina: can do hero art and a leaderboard mock. need copy for CTA and consent blurb
sara: landing copy draft: "Bring a prompt. Watch models score live. See tradeoffs between latency & cost." short and punchy
zoe: run-of-show (minute bullets):
- 0:00-0:03 intro + rules (host)
- 0:03-0:12 demo: baseline vs tuned (product)
- 0:12-0:32 live submissions + scoring (ops + eng)
- 0:32-0:42 panel takeaways + best practices
- 0:42-0:50 CTA + next steps + prizes
mike: fallback options:
1) switch to precomputed batch scoring and explain delay
2) show pre-recorded demo clips
3) pause leaderboard and continue panel
ops-bot: RECORDING_ENABLED: true
zoe: lead routing rules: add hidden field interest=pilot|bench|partner; if interest==pilot AND attended-> tag sdr_pilot
kai: rehearsal windows: Tue 09:30 tech check, Tue 11:00 full run, Wed 08:45 warmup
nina: quick asset note: avoid tiny monospace on slides; video compression kills small fonts
sara: tweet drafts ready. planning replay email: t+1h with leaderboard snapshot + top prompts
zoe: KPI checklist: live attendees, submissions, median scoring latency, pilot signups in 7d
mike: agree. set alert if scoring p50 > 2.5s or queue depth > 100
zoe: prizes: top 3 prompts get early access credit + swag. helps drive submissions
kai: volunteers: need 3 helpers to seed prompts for first 10m. zoe will recruit in #help
sara: legal: confirm consent for leaderboard display (anonymize handles). tagging legal in #help
zoe: final ask: assets by Mon noon, landing + form by Mon 3pm, dry-run Tue 10am. i'll assemble host script
mike: ack, scheduling dry-run now :thumbsup:
